name: Recital F
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text: whereas the People's Republic of China’s domestic and international policy has reduced space for partnership and increased competition with the EU and other democracies; whereas China is, of its own accord, clearly shifting EU-China relations towards systemic rivalry; whereas, cooperating where possible, competing fairly and confronting where required is essential to protect EU interests; whereas it is becoming essential for the EU to build leverage while engaging with China;
